AnswerWaitEnd.description: Why a letter stopped waiting for an answer nobody gave.

oneOf.description: The sender's or the recipient's registration ended.
The letter was sent 24 hours ago and no answer came.

BellTurn.description: The native session and submitted bell digest that own this intake.

ack_command.description: The command that acknowledges the letter, for an agent with no prompt hook to confirm it.

answer_wait_ended.description: Set when the wait for an answer ended without one; null otherwise.

bell_line.description: The line the doorbell typed for this letter last, saved with its reservation before it was typed; null until the first bell. A submitted prompt is that bell exactly when it is this line.

immediate.description: Sent with `hide request send --now`: delivered at the recipient's next safe gap while it works, without the mid-turn wait (PRD letters-to-busy-agents D-05). An older build drops the field at its next save, and the letter then waits as any other.

intake_from.description: Where the letter's wait for intake began: on its recipient machine's clock while the ledger keeps one (`Ledger::node_clocks`), on the wall clock otherwise; null is its creation on the wall clock.

tool_handovers.description: How many tool events handed the letter over while its recipient worked (PRD letters-to-busy-agents D-11): a handover is confirmed by the script once the host kept it, and after three unconfirmed ones the letter waits for the next prompt or `hide inbox`, as it does after three bells.

WarningReceipt.description: The inactivity episode and external notification reservation survive the watch itself, so stopping/restarting or sibling watches cannot resend.
